name: Bear My Breath
source:
Centered around the rather mediocre life of Erin, he's to chose his own destiny in which he must not fail, else, he will return to his ever uneventful life.

[From [url=https://tavios.itch.io/bear-my-breath]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以艾琳相当平庸的生活为中心，他要选择自己的命运，他不能失败，否则，他将回到平静的生活。

[来自[url=https://tavios.itch.io/bear-my-breath]Itch.io[/url]]
